title: Research line (a family of work sharing one core design bet)
description: The atlas's primary organizing unit. A line is not an axis option and not a capability domain: it is a coherent research program defined by a shared bet, with its own arc, evidence, and open questions.

one_line.description: The core bet in a single plain sentence.

core_bet.description: What design choice defines membership in this line — the claim a paper has to make to belong here.

primary_axis.description: Which design axis this line's defining bet is placed on.

status.description: Where the line stands as of the last review. 'contested' means live disagreement about whether it works, not that it failed.

arc.description: The line's narrative spine: problem -> idea -> method -> evidence -> limitation -> next. Every paper listed here must also declare this line in its own `lines` field.

open_questions.description: Problem ids this line has not resolved.

competes_with.description: Other line ids that answer the same question differently.

explains.description: Path to the MDX deep dive for this line.
